en.tagline: A boutique resort set around a large pool in Kabalana, Ahangama, on the south coast of Sri Lanka.
en.closing: Booking direct gets you our best rate, and if there's anything you'd like to ask first, send us a WhatsApp.

copyBlocks.heading: Welcome to Panta Rei
copyBlocks.body:
Welcome to our boutique resort in Kabalana, Sri Lanka. In Panta Rei you can escape the hustle and bustle of daily life and immerse yourself in a tropical paradise where surfing, yoga, crystal blue beaches and rainforests come together.

The resort features 16 bungalows, each with its own charm and style, inspired by wild nature and made from natural materials.

copyBlocks.heading: The pool
copyBlocks.body:
The bungalows sit in a ring around a long pool with a stone deck and loungers, and the garden runs between them.

The pool opens early in the morning, so you can swim before breakfast. If you're staying nearby, you can come for the day too.

copyBlocks.heading: Restaurant and bar
copyBlocks.body:
The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, dinner and cocktails all day, to guests and to anyone who drops in. Breakfast goes from smoothie bowls, granola and banana oat pancakes to shakshuka, or the Sri Lankan plate with egg hoppers, dhal and coconut sambal. Later there's a fish bowl, the curry of the day and a whole grilled fish, priced on weight. Dinner is a mix of traditional and modern Mediterranean dishes.

The bar is upstairs, above the restaurant. Go up for the sunset.

copyBlocks.heading: Panta Fitness Club
copyBlocks.body: An open-air fitness area on the upper floor looks out over the resort. Vinyasa yoga is at 8:30 every morning; Friday is the day off. There are Pilates classes too, led by experienced instructors, and in the season the schedule gets longer. You don't need to book.

copyBlocks.heading: After the surf
copyBlocks.body:
The Surf Therapy Massage was put together for surfers. It's a full body oil massage that works on every muscle with sport massage techniques, for the physical demands of surfing, and helps your body recover faster.

There's a Revitalizing massage as well. Either one is an hour on the whole body, or 45 minutes on the back, neck and shoulders.

copyBlocks.heading: Four ways to stay
copyBlocks.body:
Every room has air conditioning, hot water and wifi, is cleaned daily, and comes with breakfast.

Prices move with the dates. Pick yours on our booking page and you'll see what's free and what it costs.

copyBlocks.heading: Groups and retreats
copyBlocks.body: Planning to bring a big group to Sri Lanka? Whether it's for yoga, surfing, or simply soaking up the chilled island vibes, our resort is ready to host you. We'll take care of all the meals and accommodation, so you can focus on what matters most: enjoying every moment together.

copyBlocks.heading: Getting here and around
copyBlocks.body:
Kabalana Beach is a short walk away and Koggala Lake about 1.5 km. Koggala Airport is 5 km from the resort, Kathaluwa station 1.9 km and Ahangama station 2.1 km.

Tuk tuk drivers wait at the door of the hotel. Agree the price before you set off, or ask us to call one. If you'd rather have a private taxi, we'll arrange it.

testimonials.quote: We stayed here in January, and of all the places we've stayed on our travels, this was the best resort so far. Incredibly clean throughout, you can tell housekeeping is taken seriously here, and the whole place is managed to a standard you rarely find. One of the owners was around during our stay, and you could immediately tell how much he genuinely cares about the resort and his guests, on top of being a very friendly guy. The employees match that energy: attentive, warm and top notch across the board. Can't recommend Panta Rei enough, we'll be back.
testimonials.author: Peter

testimonials.quote: Incredible! We stayed at Panta Rei for 1 week, and it was wonderful. The room was very clean and had all the necessary amenities, the pool and garden area was beautiful and very quiet, the food was impeccable, one of the best we ate in Sri Lanka. The workers are very helpful and attentive. We would definitely choose it again if we return to Sri Lanka!
testimonials.author: Alba R

testimonials.quote:
We had an amazing stay in Panta Rei. The room was spacious, quiet, and nicely decorated. The food was extremely tasty.
A big shout-out to the incredible staff, always helpful and kind. We really felt at home.
testimonials.author: Arianna, Italy

testimonials.quote: I had a lovely stay! The food was excellent, and the staff were incredibly welcoming, friendly and attentive throughout my visit. Everyone made me feel comfortable and well looked after. Thank you for such a pleasant experience!
testimonials.author: Lynette

testimonials.quote: Everything thing was amazing, the room was clean, the pool was beautiful, the food was amazing, the staff are amazing, always very warm and welcoming
testimonials.author: Oishanee, India

testimonials.quote: The hospitality and the atmosphere was great. The staff were very helpful as well.
testimonials.author: Akhila, Sri Lanka
